Name: TV channel - gardening with Hisame
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
This mod ads a new TV channel to your TVs. 
It's a gardening channel with tips and tricks on how to improve aesthetically your SDV game. 

Drag and drop the mod  folder and the TV channel should appear automatically. Always get your mods from Nexus for safety and support of modder's work.
I welcome any[b] translations[/b] versions to it. 
You can best contact me on my Discord server: https://discord.gg/VxXzZwY Do not report bugs in my Discord, just here on Nexus where they are saved and documented. I can not fix them myself because I can not code, I rely on kindness of strangers. If you wish to help then please do contact me on Discord.
I have tested all my mods, anything I post works fine for me with updated SMAPI and Content Patcher, so make sure you have everything right before reporting bugs. 

The YT channel where I posted my tips and tricks originally:
[url=https://www.youtube.com/c/hisameartwork]https://www.youtube.com/c/hisameartwork

[/url]*Viewer feedback*
You can write me tips and tricks to ad to the TV channel! In the post thread here on Nexus.
I will reply on TV saying I got mail from viewer X with an idea.
-> next update I will ad pond color tips and tricks,
-> as well as where to find certain statues. 
-> horse racecourse track
-> Pam's renovation
So if you have any other ideas, let me know



[u][b]Thank you to the people who kept this mod alive past 5 years[/b][/u]
- Original author was [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/44453432]bashNinja[/url] the creators of the TV news channel. He gave me the files to make my gardening mod but some stuff was missing and so the files were useless. 
- Ricesautes(I can't find his Nexus link) redid the mod, I think from scratch? Not sure, I can't code, I don't understand how this stuff works, I only did the art. But it was done right before the 1.4 SDV update so the mod shortly stopped working so I took the mod down because Rice became unresponsive on Discord where we communicated. Hope you are well. 
-   [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48334523]EpicBellyFlop45[/url] resurrected this mod for you guys to finally enjoy. And enjoy it while you still can since I don't know who will be able to maintain it in the future since it requires apparently good knowledge of C#.
- Latest person to rescue the mod is [b]kath40[/b]! They did the CP conversion, thank you so much! 
 
*Do not download this mod from any other place other than Nexus. I do not post my mods another places and thus only guarantee virus free content here.
